name: 2015 livery (swoosh)
description: White aircraft with a broad orange swoosh: it starts over the cockpit, wraps the crown and the forward windows (white 'easyJet' title on it), and sweeps down past the wing to a point low on the aft fuselage; a second orange sweep rises from the belly into an all-orange fin with 'easyJet' in white running up it. Orange engines and sharklets.

A320neo G-UZLZ from the left, landing, 2025-03-05: the same, a little from below.

areas.name: swoosh from the cockpit roof to a point aft of the wing

titles.style: The easyJet wordmark: very heavy, rounded, soft-serifed lowercase with a capital J, white on the orange over the forward windows, just aft of the front door. Baseline just above the window tops; measured directly off G-UZLY (2024-06-11): cap 0.34, lowercase 0.78 of the J.

The wordmark again, large, in white, set along the fin: its baseline rises at about 60° from near the root (mid-chord) to the tip, reading upward toward the leading edge's top. Drawn horizontal by tools that can't rotate text.

notes: Drawn from A320neo G-UZLY and G-UZLZ and A321neo G-UZMH (2024-2025); easyJet Europe (OE-) and easyJet Switzerland (HB-) aircraft wear the same scheme. The fin title's baseline runs from fin (0.30, 0.107) to about (0.905, 0.826) on the A320: about 6 m at 44°, so its length (a share of the chord at its start) is over 1. The belly isn't seen clearly in the photos used: the swoosh's spike and the tail sweep may meet under the aft fuselage; left white. Before 2015 easyJet flew white with an orange tail and engines and huge 'easyJet.com' titles; a few older A319s may still carry it. Re-checked 2026-11-15 on G-UZLY fitted to the measured A320 shape: both areas' edges measured as curves (smooth; the swoosh's spike is its one real corner), the swoosh's lower edge a little lower over the forward door than first drawn and its top leaving the crown about x 0.27; the title re-measured with photo_trace.py probe on both photos: from x 0.155 to 0.297 (G-UZLZ 0.164 to 0.309), baseline on the windows' tops (y 0.28: G-UZLY's probe reads 0.245 but its windows 0.03 low against the shape's), cap height the 'J''s, 0.27 (the lowercase stand 0.8 of it, taller than a stand-in typeface's, so a render's lowercase looks smaller than the aircraft's).
history: Replaces Skyarium v1's approximation (white with an orange fin). The 2015 swoosh replaced the 'easyJet.com' titles scheme.
